notes: Hand-ranked keys for loot on each map, best first. Checked 2026-11-08 against tarkov.dev's current spawn lists, each key's EFT Wiki 'Behind the Lock' section and its last edit date, and guides dated 2026.
Picks resting only on a pre-1.0 source (before 2025-11-15) were dropped, because many rooms changed at 1.0.
tarkov.dev's loose-loot lists contain no ammo at all, so ammo picks rest on the wiki, guides and the containers by the door. Say 'ammo packs' unless a source names the tier.
key is the item's English name; the ETL adds price, uses and what has been seen by the door, and warns when a name or door no longer matches.
loot is any of: marked-keys, keycards, bitcoin, ledx, gpu, ammo, weapons, valuables, tech, cash.

customs.why: The map's marked room: very rare valuables, weapons, containers and any Labs keycard. The most contested door on Customs.
Cheap. The wiki lists the 314 marked key among its many key spawns (spawn data does not confirm that one), with two wooden ammo boxes, a weapon box and a weapon rack.
GP coins, valuables, a PMC body and rare modded rifles and SMGs.
The best ammo door on the map: two wooden ammo boxes, two grenade boxes and a weapon locker.
Two large weapon boxes, two safes and an intel folder spawn.
Very cheap ammo stop: loose ammo packs and one or two weapon boxes.
Safe, loose ammo packs and cash, a pistol spawn, and the gas station storage key.

factory.why: The only real loot door here, and expensive: two TerraGroup safes, a possible LEDX and possible Bitcoin.

woods.why: Best key on the map: loose valuables, two weapon boxes, and military battery and power filter spawns.
Sold by Ref. Yellow keycard spawn, valuables and rare modded marksman rifles.
Guaranteed military battery, plus TarCoin and blue folders in the sink.
A large weapon box and several 60-round AK magazines. Also opens the bunker extract.

lighthouse.why: Valuables, containers, weapon mods and ammo packs, with Bitcoin and graphics cards seen in the room.
Marked room with a weapon case, modded weapons and ammo packs.
Sold by Ref. Red keycard spawn, a graphics card, valuables and rare melee weapons.
Cheap. A Bitcoin spawn on the chair, a wooden ammo box and two weapon boxes, inside Rogue territory.

lighthouse.key: Water treatment plant storage room key
lighthouse.why: Technical supply crate, loose military tech and valuables.
Cheap. Ammo packs, a weapon box, PC block, and valuables and cash on the desk.
Cheap. Military electronics in the sink and frequent valuables. Its wiki page is old, but current spawn data backs it.

shoreline.key: Health Resort east wing room 222 key
shoreline.why: Opens through to 226. A Bitcoin spawn in the cardboard box, several LEDX spawns in 226 and three good weapon spawns. Cheaper than the 226 key.

shoreline.key: Health Resort west wing room 301 key
shoreline.why: Reaches 304 too: several LEDX and up to three graphics card spawns, plus a large weapon box.

shoreline.key: Health Resort office key with a blue tape
shoreline.why: East wing 110. Multiple LEDX spawns in the bathroom and a possible graphics card. Heavily contested.

shoreline.key: Health Resort west wing room 222 key
shoreline.why: Cheapest way through 222, 221 and 218: Red keycard spawn and ammo packs in 218, plus RSASS and SV-98 spawns.

shoreline.key: Health Resort east wing room 205 key
shoreline.why: Opens through to 206: Red keycard spawn, four weapon boxes and rare loose loot. Cheaper than the 206 key.

shoreline.key: Health Resort west wing room 205 key
shoreline.why: Opens through to 203: Red keycard spawn, two LEDX spawns and a graphics card. Cheaper than the 203 key.
Away from the resort: Yellow keycard spawn, safes, gun cabinets and a PC block.

reserve.why: Top marked room on the map, with the most rare spawns seen. Heavily camped.
Same very rare loot table as RB-BK.
Same rare table, plus three drawers. Players rate it the weakest of the three.
Non-marked but rich: loose valuables and electronics, an intel folder, and Bitcoin seen in the room.
Best ammo and military room: loose ammunition, three weapon boxes, two grenade boxes, tank batteries and shells.
Cheap tech room: two PC blocks, graphics cards, Virtex and Tetriz spawns, and several ammo boxes.
Loose ammunition and weapon mods with two weapon boxes.
Cheap: one to three wooden ammo boxes and two weapon racks.

interchange.key: Kiba Arms inner grate door key
interchange.why: Needs the expensive outer door key too, and power on. Ammo packs, armor plates, three weapon boxes and rare rifles on the racks.
Needs power. Valuables and stims, with four LEDX-listed spots by the door.
Needs power. Modded M4A1s, three weapon boxes and rare item spawns, and it opens the Saferoom extract.
Sold by Ref. Green keycard spawn, ammo packs, armor plates and rare modded rifles.
Three weapon boxes, weapon mods and valuables.
Cheap LEDX chance, plus two medbags and a defibrillator spawn.

streets-of-tarkov.why: Best marked room on Streets: very rare valuables, weapons, containers and keycards.
Very rare. Spawn data records marked keys for other maps about 20 m from this door, and a 2026 player guide agrees. The wiki also lists ammo packs.
Same very rare table as the other marked rooms. Players rate it behind the Abandoned Factory.

streets-of-tarkov.key: MVD academy entrance hall guard room key
streets-of-tarkov.why: Cheap, and rated the top ammo farm on the map: loose ammo packs and valuables, with an ORSIS T-5000M spawn.
Rated level with MVD for ammo: ammo packs, two weapon boxes, a grenade box, a weapon locker and rifle racks.
Cheap ammo farm: ammo packs, weapons and mods, two PC blocks and a safe.
Cheap: two wooden ammo boxes, two weapon boxes and a grenade box by the door.
Prison cells: Bitcoin seen at several spots, plus valuables and ammo packs.
A cash register and bank safe in each booth, for roubles, dollars and euros.
Cheap valuables room with Bitcoin and graphics cards seen at its spots.

the-lab.why: Best overall: Kruglov's office and the experiment room, with the most Bitcoin spawns seen in the Lab.
Red keycard spawn, a weapon safe, valuables and electronics. Rated level with Black.
Three weapon boxes, weapon mods, cash, and an RFID reader spawn on the server rack.
The best ammo door in the Lab: multiple ammunition spawns, weapon mods and racks of modded rifles.

the-lab.key: TerraGroup Labs weapon testing area key
the-lab.why: Cheap for the Lab: loose ammunition and mods, plus two weapon boxes.
Valuables, intel and blue folders, with Bitcoin seen at several spots.

the-lab.key: TerraGroup Labs manager's office room key
the-lab.why: Blue keycard spawn, two PC blocks, a safe and valuables.

ground-zero.why: Best value at low level: a wooden ammo box, two weapon boxes and a grenade box.
Three PC blocks and four drawers.

ground-zero.key: Unity Credit Bank cash register key
ground-zero.why: Very cheap. Loose currency, a locked safe and a drawer.

the-labyrinth.why: Very rare valuables and containers, and the richest spawn list in the Labyrinth.
Valuables, electronics and stims, with Labrys research notes.
No wiki entry yet, but Bitcoin and graphics cards are seen by the door.

icebreaker.why: Four LEDX in the overseeing cabin. Rarely listed, so its flea price is unreliable. No insurance on this map.
Opens eight cabins of electronics, meds and provisions, the most doors per card.
Sports bag and loose valuables and stims.
